description: Get one file of the installed plugin's file tree by path, with its content and summary. Workflow settings are read this way, e.g. "settings/SETTINGS.md". `pluginId` targets another plugin of the project instead of the installed one.

pluginId.description: Id of the plugin to act on (see plugins_list); the installed plugin if omitted (CLI: --plugin-id).

name: plugins_files_get
title: Get plugin file
